Evidence from the datasheet: the ordering table defines **one configuration per part number** (model + nominal HP wavelength). `-E` parts are the same wavelength with extended temperature only. Global technical data applies to all parts: **G.694.2**, **GbE**, **1G FC**, **1.0625/1.25 Gbps**, receiver wavelength **1260–1620 nm**, transmit **1271–1611 nm**. `SO-SFP-L160DH-Cxx` / `-Cxx-E` are family placeholders, not orderable modes. No mode-specific penalties were supplied. Bit rate and standards are not split per ordering row, so each mode uses **1.25** (receiver specs footnote @ 1.25 Gbps) and **G.694.2** (CWDM grid); **1260.0** / **1620.0** are the stated module receiver wavelength range.
